q_ashen_toll.title: The Ashen Toll
q_ashen_toll.description: Brother Ivenn, the last lamplighter of the Vale, begs you to thin the Hollowed that wander the ruins and to recover the scattered fragments of the Reliquary Lamp. Only the reassembled lamp can unseal the Sunken Reliquary below.

objectives.text: Find the Shrine of the Broken Saint

q_hollow_bishop.title: The Hollow Bishop
q_hollow_bishop.description: The lamp burns again. Descend into the Sunken Reliquary, light the warding brazier at its heart, and end Vorthane, the bishop who swallowed the dawn.
